purpose: Per-layer raw vs rank-64 matched-format-projected purpose/transfer AUCs and gap-rescue diagnostics for all layers of Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, Llama-3.3-70B, joined from results/layer_sweep_full320-v3_<model>.json (raw) and results/full320_v3_erasure_full_layer_sweep.json (rank-64 matched-format projection). No new probes fit; pure derived join.

definitions.delta_gap: raw_gap - proj_gap (positive = projection shrinks the gap)
definitions.rescue_fraction: delta_gap / raw_gap, only defined where |raw_gap| >= 0.01 AUC; otherwise null and flagged unstable
definitions.purpose_formed_region: layers with raw_joint_auc >= 0.95, defined from the raw trajectory only
